summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus by Crino — by lot the bride of Arbelus son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus married the Danaids at Argos.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Oeme second among the daughters of Danaus borne on Crino. When the youngest sons of Egyptus by Hephaestine cast lots, Arbelus drew Oeme. On the wedding night she received her father's dagger and, like her sisters, slew her bridegroom — Hyginus counts her among the brides who obeyed Danaus.
